cleaner_intro: Find Workshop GMA files you are no longer subscribed to in Steam content, Garry’s Mod cache, and addons. Loose folders and files without a Workshop ID are left alone.
cleaner_progress_subscriptions: Checked {completed, number} of {total, plural, one {# subscription} other {# subscriptions}}
cleaner_progress_files: {completed, plural, one {# file or folder checked} other {# files and folders checked}} · {found, plural, one {# file to clean} other {# files to clean}}
cleaner_progress_deleting: Processed {completed, number} of {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {found, number} deleted
cleaner_progress_recycling: Processed {completed, number} of {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {found, number} moved to Trash
cleaner_waiting_steam: Waiting for Steam · last reply {seconds, number}s ago
cleaner_details_loading: Loading Workshop names and icons for {count, plural, one {# addon} other {# addons}} · waiting {seconds, number}s
cleaner_error_details: Could not load Workshop names and icons. {detail}
cleaner_empty: No unsubscribed Workshop GMA files found.
cleaner_select_all: Select all {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
cleaner_selected: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}} · {size}
cleaner_confirm_delete: Permanently delete {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} ({size})? This cannot be undone.
cleaner_confirm_trash: Move {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} ({size}) to Recycle Bin / Trash? Empty it later to free disk space.
cleaner_result: {removed, plural, one {# file removed} other {# files removed}}. {failed, plural, one {# file could not be removed} other {# files could not be removed}}.
cleaner_error_offline: Steam is offline. Connect Steam and scan again.
cleaner_error_subscriptions: Could not verify all subscriptions. Scan again when Steam is online. {detail}
cleaner_error_account: The Steam account changed. Scan again.
cleaner_error_file: Could not access or remove a file: {detail}
cleaner_error_changed: The file or addon location changed. Scan again.
cleaner_error_link: This location contains a filesystem link. Choose a folder without links and scan again.
cleaner_error_scan: This scan is no longer valid. Scan again.
cleaner_error_busy: Another cleanup operation is running. Wait for it to finish.
cleaner_error_gmod: Garry’s Mod was not found. Set its folder in Settings and scan again.
cleaner_error_subscribed: This addon is subscribed or downloading. Its file was kept.
cleaner_error_retained: The file was not moved to Trash. It is still in its original location.
addon_preview_error: Could not load the addon preview: {error}
ERR_SOURCE_CHANGED: A source file changed while packaging. Select the source again and retry.
ERR_UNSAFE_ENTRY: The extraction target contains an unsafe path, filesystem link, or conflicting file.
ERR_GMA_CHECKSUM: The archive checksum does not match its contents.
ERR_ARCHIVE_LIMIT: The archive exceeds a supported resource limit.
ERR_NO_SAFE_DESTINATION: No safe extraction destination is available.
ERR_RECYCLE_RETAINED: The previous directory was retained for recovery. Move it to the trash manually if it is no longer needed.
ERR_SETTINGS_FIELD: This settings field cannot be changed by this operation.
ERR_SETTINGS_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Recover the damaged settings file before saving changes.
ERR_DOWNLOAD_DUPLICATE: This item is already queued or downloading. Follow its existing job.
ERR_DOWNLOAD_STALLED: The download made no progress for two minutes. Other queued downloads can continue.
ERR_COLLECTION_EXPANSION: The Workshop collection could not be expanded.
ERR_COLLECTION_STALLED: Steam did not return the collection details within two minutes.
ERR_PUBLISH_JOURNAL: The publishing recovery record could not be saved.
ERR_PUBLISH_UNRESOLVED: An earlier publish has an uncertain outcome. Review Publishing recovery before retrying.
ERR_PUBLISH_EXISTING_ITEM: This source already created a Workshop item. Update that item instead of creating another.
ERR_PUBLISH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Steam has not confirmed the outcome. The upload files are retained; inspect Publishing recovery before retrying.
ERR_PUBLISH_ID_UNKNOWN: Steam has not returned an item ID. Find the item in your Workshop and enter its ID to recover it.
ERR_PUBLISH_RECONCILE_TIMEOUT: Steam did not return the item details. Its publishing outcome remains uncertain.
ERR_PUBLISH_RECOVERY_OWNER: The recovery item must be a Garry's Mod Workshop item that you own.
ERR_PUBLISH_RECOVERY_ID: The recovery ID does not match the item created by this operation.
ERR_JOB_DATA_DELIVERY: Some job data could not be delivered. The recorded final outcome is preserved.
settings_recovery_body: Your settings file could not be read. Saving is paused until you choose a recovery option. The damaged file will be preserved for diagnosis.
publish_outcome_unknown: Steam outcome uncertain. Files are retained; review Publishing recovery.
publish_cleanup_warning: Published successfully; temporary cleanup needs attention.
publish_remote_observed: Steam currently shows "{title}". This does not confirm that every submitted change completed.
publish_recovery_reviewed: I checked Steam; use this existing item
publish_recovery_confirm: Confirm that you inspected this item in Steam and will use its existing ID for any retry. The original request may still complete. This action does not resubmit anything or delete retained upload files.
job_connection_error: Job updates are unavailable. Reconnecting to the saved job state...

workshop_estimated_size_help: Selected file contents before archive headers. Steam's download size may differ.
workshop_stats_help: Steam Workshop totals. Hover over a date for the exact local time. Last updated refers to the Workshop item.
workshop_settings_help: Manage visibility and required addons separately from file uploads and description edits.

workshop_visibility_help_friends_only: Only you and your Steam friends can view this addon.
workshop_visibility_help_private: Only you can view this addon.

workshop_reload_review: Reload status and review pending changes
workshop_owner_only: Only the owner can change these Workshop settings.
workshop_dependencies_help: List the addons people need alongside this one. Adding a requirement does not subscribe you to it.
workshop_no_dependencies: This addon has no required addons.
workshop_dependency_unavailable: Private or deleted; you can still remove the requirement
workshop_search_placeholder: Search by name, or paste a Workshop link / ID
workshop_search_help: Searches Garry's Mod addons. Paste an individual addon's link or ID to look it up directly.
workshop_search_empty: No addons found. Try a different name or paste a Workshop link.
workshop_discard_confirm: Discard your unsaved visibility and required-addon changes? Changes already saved to Steam will be kept.
workshop_no_visibility: No visibility types selected. Check a type in Filters to show addons.

workshop_load_error: Could not load your Workshop addons. {error}
workshop_incomplete: Steam returned an empty page before all addons were loaded. Try loading again.
workshop_save_error: Could not save your Workshop preferences. Your previous choices have been restored. {error}
